bootstrap_weight_test.description: omitted persons receive frequency zero; selected-person support count matches

concept: RP/spouse combined real gross labor earnings (2022 dollars per source builder)
fit: stationary persistent AR(1) plus iid transitory at four-year frequency; rho in [1e-8,1-1e-8], both variances >=0
period_definition: sum of four observed annual gross earnings; log mean used for covariance because log(sum)=log(mean)+constant
residualization: weighted least squares of log four-year mean on block-start integer age and block-start calendar-year fixed effects

source_variable_labels.AGEREP: Ind's reported age at time of interview
source_variable_labels.DEATHYEAR: Ind's death year, last reported or best estimate
source_variable_labels.EARNINDRRC: RP/SP's combined earnings (real USD 2022), tax year

synthetic_observer_recovery.note: Finite-sample bias reflects the empirical unbalanced block shape plus the same block-start age/year FE residualization; this is a measurement check, not a calibration target.

timing_contract.EARNINDRRC: RP/SP's combined earnings (real USD 2022), tax year
timing_contract.interpretation: retain survey-year label for year; source labels EARNINDRRC as tax-year earnings. No survey-to-tax-year shift was applied; a common shift would not change within-person covariance but remains a reporting limitation.

weight_definition: geometric mean of four annual IW weights for each block; geometric mean of block weights for covariance pairs
